text:
nina_sales: Quick sync before tomorrow's EdgeFlow demo. Customer needs: SAML on Dedicated, streaming backpressure behavior (they have a mutating proxy), and a short pricing example for brief 200-300rps spikes. Can we split owners?

sam_engineering: I'll take SAML runbook + one-pager. Dedicated supports SAML + SCIM. Steps: upload IdP metadata -> test -> enable SCIM. Will include sample metadata XML.

jenna_solutions: I'll own streaming notes. SDK emits newline-delimited JSON frames. Backpressure handled by server control frames (type:control, code:503) and SDK performs jittered exponential backoff and retry. Recommend ephemeral stream tokens TTL=10m for POC. Tiny ws example for call: `ws on message -> parse ndjson`

omar_infra: Operational note: Private/on-prem adds infra license. For VPC peering we need customer to allow outbound TLS to control-plane and we do mTLS for agent comms. Also short checklist for firewall rules ready.

kate_se: Security: we support BYOK via KMS/Vault on Dedicated/Private, can provide SOC2 artifact list and MFA requirement docs. Will attach before EOD.

nina_sales: Pricing: show reserved 50rps baseline + burst to 300rps for ~10min. Sam, can you draft a slide showing reserved vs reserved+burst credits vs pure on-demand?

sam_engineering: Yep. Also note very short spikes can exceed model concurrency; recommend fallback to smaller model or queueing to keep p99 latency sensible.

jenna_solutions: POC runbook (short): 1) Enable test SAML tenant; 2) Issue ephemeral tokens; 3) Run curl stream healthcheck; 4) Switch to FuncJSON tool flow with 2 schemas; 5) Capture Console trace + cost sample.

omar_infra: I'll drop VPC peering checklist and runbook bits here by 17:00.

deploybot: Reminder: control-plane deploy tonight 23:00 UTC. No expected disruption to Dedicated tenants. :rocket:

nina_sales: Thanks all 1 — will share customer questionnaire in thread and confirm demo time.
